notes.title: Chuck's Challenge 3D 2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5650189/b7e798918fc6d15a6fa1cda7dfb737e5909f96de.png[/img]

It's been 10 years since we launched Chuck's Challenge, so we wanted to honour this by creating a new remastered version. Over the last 14 months [b]Chuck’s Challenge 3D 2020[/b] has been rebuilt for desktop and is available now as a free update as a thank you for all the people who've bought CC3D on Steam: 
[list]
[*][b]Remastered Graphics[/b]
[*][b]Redesigned GUI [/b]
[*][b]Refined Gameplay[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5650189/bda5f6cfef84ba71609d6870df8ba8a208762e62.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5650189/63df676b14bf3fcfa2552ad1318c84d58153666e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5650189/0927f1ad66a7b177bcfde1aea8c819a7b71c18f1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5650189/1e20983063b75e5e3cc398a15cfb1b69f0e68092.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5650189/60c34dfd8af3f071b4f397a4bc97eefd3a45614f.png[/img]

[b]Remastered Graphics[/b]
CC3D 2020 runs in the latest Unity 3D game engine, plus Woop has got a new higher resolution body. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5650189/0f465db9a69bf7a10f819baae9c040ada2651227.png[/img]

[b]Redesigned GUI [/b]
The Graphic User Interface has been redesigned, so no more Windows 8 horizontal scrolling  interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5650189/d91d6b6c29eeedf065707ddd5afb31849d669dcb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5650189/e68df78ead9cb47e603901df895080fec94d6eca.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5650189/e65b68720b7b46af770fd48640f4d8ae312e04df.png[/img]

[b]Refined Gameplay[/b]
There's a new optional hop animation that lets you clearly see which square Woop is in. You can play the game at three different speeds depending on your mood. Plus loads of other features such as the number of Steps to complete a level is now counted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5650189/6ef7f8df9d2e49d1076ead015ce2fad7e2939f3f.png[/img]

ːcc3dwhoopː We hope you enjoy the latest version of Chuck's Challenge - CC3D 2020 ːcc3dwhoopː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5650189/aa0f0812af7e1f7d0f4d5cec639195bf6c1f58b8.png[/img]

notes.title: Alien Support
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5650189/e28245526150cf22c155fd181476e57de18ec67d.png[/img]

[b]Chuck’s Challenge 3D[/b] and [b]Ben 10 Game Generator 5D[/b] both share the same engine. However they have different logic and Game Elements. The good news is this means that while we've been polishing the engine for [b]Ben 10 Game Generator 5D[/b], we’ve also been able to update [b]Chuck’s Challenge 3D[/b] too. So today we've released an update for [b]Chuck’s Challenge 3D[/b] which includes:
[list]
    [*]Faster Server
    [*]Refined Mini-Blur
    [*]New Tap Control
[/list]
Plus we’ve been fixing lots of minor bugs, but also two big ones:
[olist]
    [*][b]Play Bug[/b] - the game not always remember you’ve completed a level if the server is being slow to respond.
    [*][b]Create Bug[/b] - not always being able to load levels you’ve save locally
[/olist]
We hope you enjoy the update and the support from our alien friend.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/437510

notes.title: Chuck’s Challenge 3D - Woop's Song
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5650189/3acd9b7ce67b6277f9f8c0e26c0c7cded25232aa.png[/img]

Chuck’s Challenge 3D is getting a new feature update called Woop’s Song, including:: 
[list]
    [*][b]Feathers[/b]
    [*][b]New Search[/b]
    [*][b]Improved Score Card[/b]
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5650189/d50d418431d9976e926207ee18a0aa1a4dbf88ac.png[/img]

[b]Feathers[/b]
The number of times you use Undo is now remembered. Complete a level without using Undo and you are rewarded with a Feather for that level. Complete all 25 levels in a Bundle and you are rewarded with a special Feathered Hat. There are now 6 additional hats to collect, one for each Bundle.


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5650189/1e864e47befb5d960bcca01fdd7fa04dc4a9dffe.png[/img]

[b]New Search[/b]
A new dropdown search menu has been added, that has two extra search filters: [i]Hardest Levels[/i] & all the past [i]Weekly Puzzles[/i]. Plus the search results now show if you played the level and what Medal you got for it.


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5650189/4902dd4a7f857172542668926e846c30e36ed24b.png[/img]

[b]Improved Score Card[/b]
A number of updates have been added including showing your current and best time, how many Undos you used and most importantly how close you are to get a better Medal.


http://store.steampowered.com/app/262590

notes.title: Flummery Update with loads of new content
notes.content:
[img]http://www.chuckschallenge.com/Images/CC3DFlummeryPosterSteam.png[/img]

The [b]Flummery[/b] update arrives for the 25th anniversary of the launch of Chip's Challenge. [b]Flummery[/b] has loads of new content including:
[list]
    [*][b]+1 Flummery Bundle[/b] a tougher set of 25 levels with a new background
    [*][b]+2 Hats[/b] instead of just one when you complete [b]Flummery[/b]
    [*][b]+3 Tracks[/b] to listen to in-game while playing [b]Flummery[/b]
    [*][b]+12 Game Elements[/b] with 7 additional game objects and 5 new pets
    [*][b]& Steam Workshop[/b] integration letting players discover & discuss levels they create
[/list]
Below are some screen grabs of the new Game Elements, which you'll be able to create new levels with and post in Steam Workshop:

Baby Screamers, Red F.I.S.H. Gates & Baby Blinkys.

Cage Button, Cage & Sand.

Key Security Point, Orb Security Point & Pop-Up Walls

notes.title: New game engine for Massive Invisible Update
notes.content:
[img]http://www.chuckschallenge.com/Images/CC3DMassiveInvisible.png[/img]

Over the last 6 months Chip’s Challenge creator Chuck Sommerville has rebuilt from scratch the [b]Chuck’s Challenge 3D[/b] game engine adding 100s of new improvements & features. 

[i]“With 1,000,000s of players creating 10,000s of levels, we’ve learnt a great deal over the last few years.”[/i] Chuck Sommerville said. [i]“The [b]Massive Invisible[/b] update as the name suggests is huge. It’s so big we even thought about calling it [b]Chuck’s Challenge 4[/b].”[/i]

The [b]Massive Invisible[/b] update includes 100s of new features and improvements including:
[list]
[*][b]Hints[/b] are now uploaded along with the user-generated levels, allowing players to watch in-game how the original creator completed the level.
[*][b]Enhanced Graphics[/b] with updated models and new graphically effects that take advantages of the latest Unity 3D features making everything looks super smooth; including character animations and a new psychedelic undo effect.
[*][b]Improved Controls[/b] Woop now understands his surrounding, helping players to get even better times by moving diagonally while also avoiding walls.
[/list]
The below video from May explains further some of the new features that are included with [b]Massive Invisible[/b]: http://youtu.be/HUibXJg5TPc 
[i]“Hints are my new favorite feature.”[/i] Chuck Sommerville said. [i]“Chip’s Challenge was based on a 32x32 grid, whereas [b]Chuck’s Challenge 3D[/b] allows a 100x100 board with even more Game Elements. So it’s thrilling to watch some of the complex levels and their solutions being created by the community. Some are truly epic.”[/i]

The [b]Massive Invisible[/b] update for [b]Chuck’s Challenge 3D[/b] is on Steam for PC, Mac & Linux:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/262590 
That's the main done, now it must be time for pudding ːcc3dwhoopː

The [b]Massive Invisible[/b] update for [b]Chuck’s Challenge 3D[/b] is on Steam for PC, Mac & Linux:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/262590 
That's the main done, now it must be time for pudding :cc3dwhoop:

tags.feature: [b]Hints[/b] are now uploaded along with the user-generated levels, allowing players to watch in-game how the original creator completed the level.

[b]Enhanced Graphics[/b] with updated models and new graphically effects that take advantages of the latest Unity 3D features making everything looks super smooth; including character animations and a new psychedelic undo effect.
[b]Improved Controls[/b] Woop now understands his surrounding, helping players to get even better times by moving diagonally while also avoiding walls.

notes.title: Nearly time for pudding
notes.content:
From the creator of Chip's Challenge comes the latest update for Chuck’s Challenge 3D, which includes a loads of savoury snacks:

[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Mouse Menu Scrolling GUI[/b] - For mouse users, buttons will appear near the side of the screen when you move the mouse close to the edge.
[*][b]5 Second Penalty[/b] - when you undo you'll get a 5 seconds added to your time now instead of 1. Plus there is a little animation.
[*][b]Clone Machine Effect[/b] - objects that the clone machine will create now have a GFX.
[*][b]Deep Links[/b] - you'll be able to create a web URL that not only opens Chuck's Challenge 3D in Steam, but it will also download & play a particular levelid.
[/list]

[b]BUGS[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Hat Notification[/b] - this was being over active and so will now actually tell you when you have a new hat.
[*][b]Hat Memory[/b] - the interface remembers what hat you were wearing.
[*][b]Local & Server Levels[/b] - the game shouldn't get confused by these and local levels will be marked as 'local' in the levelid field.
[/list]

Things that we are working on but are being more default then we thought:
[list]
[*][b]Thumbnails[/b] - this one is just being mean as some old versions are over writing the new nice thumbnails, so we need a solution that gets the server and the game working together.
[*][b]Game Logic & Undo[/b] - this is work in progress because it is huge.
[*][b]Surprise[/b] - other fun stuff but it wouldn't be a surprise if we told you what it was ːcc3dwhoopː
[/list]

[/list]
We know it's been a while since we've done a bigger update but that's because we are plotting ;)

notes.title: Update v1.1.58: Full Controller Support & New Audio + Video Settings
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Chuck's Challenge 3D, we hope you are enjoying it. Over the last two weeks we’ve been working on improving the game with your most requested features. This update v1.1.58 includes:
[list]
    [*]Additional controllers supported, including Xbox 360 & PS3. Plus, restart is now bound to Y & play to X.
    [*]Refined Windows 8 style interface, automatically switching between pointer and mouse cursor.
    [*]Resolution & quality are now in-game options in Settings, this means the game now has full controller support.
    [*]The volume levels for both SFX and Music can be adjusted rather than just being toggled on or off.
    [*]Fixed the bug where the initial second is slightly shorter, hence solving the restart time hack.
[/list]
If you have any suggestion for new features please add them to the Steam discussion page.

Thank you for your support.
Team Niffler
